'''Geran''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Calaron sector/Legends|Calaron sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]].

==Description==
It was home to [[shell-bat]]s, along with the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Geranite/Legends|Geranites]], a [[near-Human]] [[Species/Legends|species]] that needed small amounts of the element [[hydron-three]] to stay alive. Believing in the [[Sky Seraphs]], [[Doallyn/Legends|Doallyn]] was a member of this race.
